parameters.query:
SELECT c.id,c.news_id,c.ticker,c.title,c.ki_relevanz,c.ki_konfidenz,c.ki_begruendung,c.false_positive_typ,c.suggested_pattern,c.suggested_pattern_type,c.suggested_match_scope,c.status,c.created_at,
       count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.ticker,c.false_positive_typ,lower(c.suggested_pattern)) AS gruppengroesse,
       COALESCE((SELECT value_numeric::integer FROM trading.pipeline_config WHERE config_key='NEWS_EXCLUSION_URGENCY_MEDIUM'),3) AS urgency_medium,
       COALESCE((SELECT value_numeric::integer FROM trading.pipeline_config WHERE config_key='NEWS_EXCLUSION_URGENCY_HIGH'),5) AS urgency_high
FROM trading.news_match_exclusion_candidates c
WHERE c.status='pending'
ORDER BY gruppengroesse DESC,c.created_at ASC
LIMIT 250;

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body||$json; const action=String(b.action||''); const id=Number(b.id); const reviewer=String(b.reviewer||'').trim().slice(0,200); const valid=Number.isInteger(id)&&id>0&&['approve','reject'].includes(action)&&reviewer.length>0; return [{json:{action,id,reviewer,query:valid?`SELECT * FROM trading.news_match_exclusion_candidates WHERE id=${id} AND status='pending'`:'SELECT NULL::bigint AS id WHERE FALSE'}}];

function pg(v){return "'"+String(v??'').replace(/'/g,"''")+"'"} const ctx=$('POST validieren + Load-Query bauen').item.json; const c=$json; if(!c?.id)return [{json:{sql:"SELECT false AS ok, 'Kandidat nicht gefunden oder nicht mehr pending' AS message"}}]; if(ctx.action==='reject')return [{json:{sql:`UPDATE trading.news_match_exclusion_candidates SET status='rejected',reviewed_at=now(),reviewed_by=${pg(ctx.reviewer)} WHERE id=${Number(c.id)} AND status='pending' RETURNING true AS ok,'abgelehnt'::text AS message`}}]; const phrase=String(c.suggested_pattern||'').trim(); const occurs=(String(c.title||'')+'\n'+String(c.raw_content||'')).toLocaleLowerCase('de-DE').includes(phrase.toLocaleLowerCase('de-DE')); const safe=phrase.split(/\s+/u).length>=2&&c.suggested_pattern_type==='exact_phrase'&&occurs; if(!safe)return [{json:{sql:`UPDATE trading.news_match_exclusion_candidates SET status='rejected',reviewed_at=now(),reviewed_by=${pg(ctx.reviewer)} WHERE id=${Number(c.id)} AND status='pending' RETURNING false AS ok,'Sicherheitspr�fung fehlgeschlagen'::text AS message`}}]; return [{json:{sql:`BEGIN; INSERT INTO trading.news_match_exclusions(ticker,pattern,pattern_type,match_scope,reason,source,aktiv) VALUES(${pg(c.ticker)},${pg(phrase)},'exact_phrase',${pg(c.suggested_match_scope||'title_and_content')},${pg(c.ki_begruendung)},'manual_review',TRUE) ON CONFLICT (ticker,lower(pattern),pattern_type,match_scope) DO UPDATE SET aktiv=TRUE,reason=EXCLUDED.reason,updated_at=now(); UPDATE trading.news_match_exclusion_candidates SET status='approved',reviewed_at=now(),reviewed_by=${pg(ctx.reviewer)} WHERE id=${Number(c.id)} AND status='pending'; COMMIT; SELECT true AS ok,'freigegeben und aktiviert'::text AS message;`}}];
